LESSON: DEVELOPMENTS IN MEDIUM OF TRADE

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: People and Relationships
Topic 2.4: Developments in medium of trade
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Developments in medium of trade, part of People and Relationships in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven SOCIAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: How has money transformed trade in Africa?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Developments in medium of trade together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and Collaboration: Learners speak effectively and logically as they compare barter trade and use of currency in Africa.

Values:
● Respect: Learners develop acceptance as they listen to each other as they brainstorm on the impact of the introduction of money in Africa,

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Self-awareness: Learners role play and barter trade and the use of currency.

Link to other Learning Areas:

• Pre-Technical studies -learners apply knowledge gained from the impact introduction of currency in Africa
